data-and-privacy.title: Your data and privacy
data-and-privacy.intro: We use your information to find your pensions, but **we do not store it**. We only hold pseudonymised codes to run the service.
identifiers: identifiers for any pensions matched to you.
data-and-privacy.research-heading: How we use your research data
research-paragraphs: We will store your research data securely. Only authorised researchers will be able to access it.
We fully anonymise all research findings that we use in presentations and reports. This means nobody will see your details or know that the findings came from you.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help analyse and summarise feedback. No personal data will be shared with any AI tool, and our research team will review any outputs before using them.
research-list: We keep research data for up to **2 years**, then we remove or anonymise it.
We follow **GDPR** and all other relevant data protection laws.
You can stop taking part at any time. This will not affect any services or support you receive from us.
data-and-privacy.removing-intro: You can ask to withdraw your research participation data by contacting [dpo@maps.org.uk_target=_self](mailto:dpo@maps.org.uk).
removing-list: We'll delete your research panel data and any research participation data that has not yet been anonymised.
Pseudonymised data in the Find service will remain stored until it is automatically deleted after **5 years of inactivity**.

agreement-and-consent.title: Agree to take part
agreement-and-consent.intro-paragraph: To use the MoneyHelper Pensions Dashboard, you must agree to the following:
listItems: You've read and agree to comply with the [website Terms and conditions](https://www.moneyhelper.org.uk/en/about-us/terms-and-conditions). These terms shall govern your use of the MoneyHelper Pensions Dashboard (“**MHPD**”) and Find your pensions (“**Find**”) service. Any references in the terms to the website is to the MHPD and Find websites;

You understand that using the MHPD and Find services requires you to confirm your identity using One Login, which is subject to the One Login terms and conditions set out here [Terms and conditions - GOV.UK One Login](https://signin.account.gov.uk/terms-and-conditions);

You understand that the MHPD and Find services are in a test phase. They may not work as intended and the content provided through them may be incomplete or inaccurate. You should not rely on this content for any financial decision-making or take any action on the basis of it;
You agree to only use the MHPD and Find services to assist the Money and Pensions Service in its testing and for personal and domestic purposes.
You understand you can stop taking part at any time, and this won't affect the service or support you get from the Money and Pensions Service (MaPS).
You understand that the ideas, designs and services on the dashboard are confidential and you won't share them.

You agree to take part in testing the MoneyHelper Pensions Dashboard and for your information to be used as specified above. You also agree that your data can be used for research (we’ll delete this data after 2 years).
You agree to be contacted for further research participation.

decline.title: Are you sure you don't want to take part in our research?
decline.content:
Currently, you can only use the service if you agree to take part in research. Click ‘Back’ if you want to change your response. 

If you don’t agree to the research terms, you can come back and use the MoneyHelper Pensions Dashboard when it’s available to the public.

sign-up-update.title: Sign up again to test the Pensions Dashboard
sign-up-update.content:
Our sign-up process has changed since you previously agreed to take part in testing the MoneyHelper Pensions Dashboard. 

You’ll need to fill in a short consent form again, including your name, email address and a few details about you for our research team. You’ll then get access to the dashboard right away.
